visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and a small earring is in an indoor room with a blurred background featuring a traditional red lantern and a blue window. He wears a white t-shirt with "NERDY" printed in multi-colored letters. He fans himself with his hands, looking distressed by heat. (2) The scene cuts as he appears wearing a black and white striped hoodie, seemingly playing a second character. He hands a glass of water towards the camera. (3) The man in the white shirt returns, looking surprised with wide eyes and an open mouth. A graphic of a water glass with ice cubes is overlaid on the screen. (4) The visuals transition to a digital interface showing a mobile game set in a snowy, frozen environment. Small animated characters in blue parkas gather logs and carry them to a central furnace. A large white polar bear prowls the perimeter. (5) A stylized 3D animation introduces a female character with white hair, oversized goggles, and a large mechanical weapon. She has a confident expression. (6) The man in the white shirt returns to the frame, talking enthusiastically. A graphic of a bowl of mango shaved ice with yellow syrup appears. (7) A final branding screen displays the game title 'Whiteout Survival' in Chinese and English, with a call to action to download.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male voice speaks fast in Mandarin over a bright, synthesized pop BGM with a clear 4/4 beat. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers a slight change in the speaker's tone as he portrays a different character. (3) A loud 'ding' SFX coincides with an increase in vocal volume and pitch variability, expressing surprise. (4) The BGM shifts to an epic orchestral style with driving percussion; sounds of howling wind and crackling fire are layered in as environmental SFX. (5) A sharp mechanical whirring and a laser pulse sound occur alongside a short, energetic female catchphrase. (6) The original pop BGM returns as the male voice speaks in a persuasive, friendly manner. A final jingle sound concludes the track.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the mobile game 'Whiteout Survival' by humorously contrasting Taiwanese and Japanese summer habits, suggesting the game as a 'cooling' entertainment alternative.
